plan.summary: BRO-5858 (part 5): after the same-url sweep, two corrected reviews stayed out of the scored set because of a stale or false-positive exclusion flag on the kept file. Clear each, with evidence.
steps: Clear the stale exclusion flag on each kept file

actions.description: BRO-5858: stale blanket flag ("web-search source has 84% fabrication rate"). The url is live: fetchPage loaded it and its byline credits Alex Wood; The Stage roundup quotes this excerpt. With the flag set the rebuild falls back to the wrong-critic copy (Sarah Crompton).
BRO-5858: human check of the url and content verification (isValid true, articleType review). Breadcrumb before clearing the obituary-heuristic nonReviewFlag.

BRO-5858: heuristic false positive (type obituary, matched "passed away": Here We Are is Sondheim posthumous musical). contentVerification on the same file says isValid true, articleType review; url is /post/review-here-we-are-lyttlelton-theatre. The flag drops the only live copy of this review.
